annotations.label: Open Daily Hygiene Checks
annotations.note: From the home screen, tap the Daily Hygiene Checklist card — every shift's hygiene check starts here.

annotations.label: Create a new checklist
annotations.note: Tap Create New Checklist to open a fresh session for the shift you're about to check.

annotations.label: Pick the shift window
annotations.note: Checks are tracked per shift — choose the slot this session belongs to.

annotations.label: Start of afternoon shift
annotations.note: We're checking the afternoon crew, so this session is tied to the start of the afternoon shift.

annotations.label: At least one inspection
annotations.note: The rule: you must personally inspect at least one operative before the session can be completed.

annotations.label: Select an operative
annotations.note: The list shows everyone on this shift. We'll start with Lindiwe Mthembu.

annotations.label: Tap the check icon
annotations.note: The check icon on the row opens the hygiene verdict dialog for that person.

annotations.label: Three possible verdicts
annotations.note: Every operative gets one of three outcomes — all clear, exception, or off duty.

annotations.label: All clear
annotations.note: Clear means you inspected them and hygiene is up to standard — nothing to report.

annotations.label: Exception
annotations.note: Exception means you found an issue — you'll record what it was and what action you took.

annotations.label: Off duty
annotations.note: Off duty takes them out of today's check — they're not on shift, so no inspection is needed.

annotations.label: Mark absentees off duty
annotations.note: Go down the list and mark everyone who isn't on shift — Precious Ndlovu is off today too.

annotations.label: Off duty, recorded
annotations.note: Same dialog, same tap — the row updates instantly, so you can always see who's accounted for.

annotations.label: Next: Sipho Dhlamini
annotations.note: Sipho has been inspected and everything looks good — open his row to record it.

annotations.label: Mark him as clear
annotations.note: One tap on All Clear and his check is done.

annotations.label: Pass All unlocks
annotations.note: With at least one inspection recorded, Pass All can clear everyone remaining in one go.

annotations.label: Capturing an exception
annotations.note: Before we finish, the important one — Naledi Mokoena has an issue we need to record properly.

annotations.label: Tap Exceptions
annotations.note: Choosing Exceptions opens the list of hygiene checks so you can pinpoint exactly what failed.

annotations.label: Pick the failed check
annotations.note: This is the full hygiene checklist — tick whichever items apply to this operative.

annotations.label: e.g. taking medication
annotations.note: In Naledi's case it's medication — a health flag the supervisor needs to know about.

annotations.label: Record the action taken
annotations.note: An exception isn't complete without the corrective action — say what you did about it.

annotations.label: Attach photo evidence
annotations.note: You can photograph the issue or the fix — the evidence is saved with the record.

annotations.label: Save the exception
annotations.note: Record Exception saves the whole story: the issue, the action taken, and any photos.

annotations.label: Made a mistake? Reopen it
annotations.note: Verdicts aren't locked in — tap the row again to change what you recorded.

annotations.label: Switch back to clear
annotations.note: Here we flip Naledi's demo entry back to All Clear — the record updates immediately.

annotations.label: Cancel backs out
annotations.note: In the verdict dialog, Cancel closes without changing anything.

annotations.label: Cancel works everywhere
annotations.note: Same on the exceptions screen — Cancel in the corner backs out safely.

annotations.label: Finish with Pass All
annotations.note: Everyone left un-flagged is cleared in one tap — the whole team is now accounted for.

annotations.label: Complete the session
annotations.note: Complete Session locks the check in — done, logged, and visible to the site.
